titles.occupation_description: Patrol assigned area, such as public parking lot or city streets to issue tickets to overtime parking violators and illegally parked vehicles.

tasks.task: Patrol an assigned area by vehicle or on foot to ensure public compliance with existing parking ordinance.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, patrol requires physical presence in the assigned area.

tasks.task: Maintain close communications with dispatching personnel, using two-way radios or cell phones.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P2 draft/route, D2. The field endpoint is still a person.

tasks.task: Write warnings and citations for illegally parked vehicles.
tasks.anchor: authority - D0 test 3 and 2. A parking summons is an appealable due-process record affirmed by the issuing agent; it looks clerical and is not.

tasks.task: Respond to and make radio dispatch calls regarding parking violations and complaints.
tasks.anchor: n/a - context_dependent, read as radio communication at the lowest-consequence plausible use (rubric context-inheritance rule). D2.

tasks.task: Train new or temporary staff.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P1, field mentoring is the material human portion; materials are producible. D2.

tasks.task: Identify vehicles in violation of parking codes, checking with dispatchers when necessary to confirm identities or to determine whether vehicles need to be booted or towed.
tasks.anchor: n/a - compound. 'Identify vehicles in violation' is P3/D3 automatable; the boot-or-tow clause is D1 (property seizure, falls on a member of the public, not cheaply reversible) and carries the statement.

tasks.task: Perform simple vehicle maintenance procedures, such as checking oil and gas, and report mechanical problems to supervisors.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, bodily act on a vehicle.

tasks.task: Observe and report hazardous conditions, such as missing traffic signals or signs, and street markings that need to be repainted.
tasks.anchor: capability - compound. 'Observe' is P0; 'report' alone would be automatable. This is the clearest erodes-with-sensors item in the set.

titles.occupation_description: Guard, patrol, or monitor premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules. May operate x-ray and metal detector equipment.

tasks.task: Patrol industrial or commercial premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, patrol.

tasks.task: Answer alarms and investigate disturbances.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, responding to an alarm is embodied.

tasks.task: Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintain security of premises.
tasks.anchor: n/a - compound. 'Monitor' is producible; 'authorize entrance' is D1 (consequence falls on a member of the public, not reversible in the moment).

tasks.task: Write reports of daily activities and irregularities, such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P2/D1(nominal). The round-1 case-3 family: a signed, discoverable activity record. Under A3's proposed widened attestation test this would move to human_anchored/authority; A3 is NOT adopted in v0.1, so it stays augmentable and is flagged.

tasks.task: Call police or fire departments in cases of emergency, such as fire or presence of unauthorized persons.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P1, recognising the emergency on scene is the material human portion; D1.

tasks.task: Circulate among visitors, patrons, or employees to preserve order and protect property.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, circulating among people to preserve order.

tasks.task: Answer telephone calls to take messages, answer questions, and provide information during non-business hours or when switchboard is closed.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P3/D3. Off-hours message-taking and information provision names no consequence and no anchored consumer.

tasks.task: Warn persons of rule infractions or violations, and apprehend or evict violators from premises, using force when necessary.
tasks.anchor: authority - D0 test 4. Apprehension, eviction, and use of force are coercive power over a person; delegation is void regardless of output quality.

titles.occupation_description: Assess injuries and illnesses and administer basic emergency medical care. May transport injured or sick persons to medical facilities.

tasks.task: Administer first aid treatment or life support care to sick or injured persons in prehospital settings.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, bodily act on a person. D0 test 5 also fires (reserved professional act, certified scope of practice); the decision procedure stops at P0 first.

tasks.task: Assess nature and extent of illness or injury to establish and prioritize medical procedures.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0/P1 hands-on assessment. D0 test 5 also fires.

tasks.task: Attend training classes to maintain certification licensure, keep abreast of new developments in the field, or maintain existing knowledge.
tasks.anchor: capability - the certification attaches to the person; the maintenance obligation cannot be delegated to a non-person.

tasks.task: Comfort and reassure patients.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, physical presence with a patient.

tasks.task: Communicate with dispatchers or treatment center personnel to provide information about situation, to arrange reception of survivors, or to receive instructions for further treatment.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P2, a structured handoff report is draftable; D1, the consequence lands on a patient and is not cheaply reversible.

tasks.task: Coordinate work with other emergency medical team members or police or fire department personnel.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P2 coordination messaging; D1, multi-agency scene coordination.

tasks.task: Decontaminate ambulance interior following treatment of patient with infectious disease, and report case to proper authorities.
tasks.anchor: capability - compound. Decontamination is P0; the mandated case report alone would be augmentable.

tasks.task: Drive mobile intensive care unit to specified location, following instructions from emergency medical dispatcher.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, driving. The single most likely item in this whole demo to erode with technology - and note that it erodes for the EMT and not for task 2138.

titles.occupation_title: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
titles.occupation_description: Keep buildings in clean and orderly condition. Perform heavy cleaning duties, such as cleaning floors, shampooing rugs, washing walls and glass, and removing rubbish. Duties may include tending furnace and boiler, performing routine maintenance activities, notifying management of need for repairs, and cleaning snow or debris from sidewalk.

tasks.task: Service, clean, or supply restrooms.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0.

tasks.task: Gather and empty trash.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0.

tasks.task: Clean building floors by sweeping, mopping, scrubbing, or vacuuming.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0.

tasks.task: Follow procedures for the use of chemical cleaners and power equipment to prevent damage to floors and fixtures.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0, embodied use of chemicals and power equipment.

tasks.task: Mix water and detergents or acids in containers to prepare cleaning solutions, according to specifications.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0.

tasks.task: Notify managers concerning the need for major repairs or additions to building operating systems.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P1/P2, spotting the fault needs presence; drafting the notification does not. D2, internal and correctable.

tasks.task: Requisition supplies or equipment needed for cleaning and maintenance duties.
tasks.anchor: n/a - P3/D3. Requisitioning from consumption data names no external consequence and is cheaply reversible.

tasks.task: Clean windows, glass partitions, or mirrors, using soapy water or other cleaners, sponges, or squeegees.
tasks.anchor: capability - P0.

titles.skip_reason: Hiring category, not an occupation — 17 salaried rows out of 2,414. Coding it as a job would corrupt the analysis. (L13, data/crosswalk_candidates.md)
